Card Q&A.a: If there are already any cards stacked under the Tamer, you place the new card at the bottom.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [On Play] effect to place a card under a Tamer that already has cards under it, in what order do I place the cards?

Effect: [On Play] By placing 1 [Bagra Army] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash under any of your Tamers, ＜Draw 1＞.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Tuwarmon] with a play cost of 7 or less from under your Tamers without paying the cost. Then, ＜Save＞.
Inherited Effect: When effects trash this card from a [Bagra Army] trait Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
